lines: 01-hook
YouTube is offering creators millions... for one thing: stay exclusive.
02-offer
According to reports, YouTube is discussing multi-million-dollar deals with its biggest creators.
03-netflix
Why? Because Netflix is coming for YouTube's biggest stars.
04-television
Netflix has been pursuing successful YouTubers. Creator content isn't just internet content anymore.
05-problem
And that's a problem. If the same superstar content lives on Netflix — what makes YouTube exclusive?
06-money
So YouTube is considering something different: financing creator shows directly, and opening up major brand deals.
07-crazy
And this is where it gets crazy.
08-shift
Creators aren't competing with Hollywood anymore. Platforms are competing for creators.
09-followers
If platforms will spend millions fighting over creator attention — brands should stop choosing creators by follower count.
10-economy
The creator economy just became the media economy. Choosing the right creator matters more than ever.
11-yoloco
Yoloco. Find the creators worth betting on.
